C1287.title: Helibao Payment Fined 74.88 Million Yuan for Four Regulatory Violations
C1287.summary: Guangzhou Helibao Payment Technology Co., Ltd. was issued a warning and public reprimand by the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China for violations of clearing management rules, payment acceptance terminal and related business regulations, merchant management rules, and account management regulations. The company had illegal gains of 12.08 million yuan confiscated and was fined 62.80 mil

references.title: Fines Exceeding Tens of Millions Are Common! Avoid These Pitfalls of Third-Party Payment Institutions
